run_metadata.coverage_summary: SEVERELY DEGRADED RUN (same outbound-egress outage as the 2026-10-21 run). The execution environment blocks outbound HTTPS: WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host (DNS not resolvable), and the agent proxy rejects direct CONNECTs, so NO tender portal, detail page or specification document could be opened. The only working external channel was WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure), which returns titles, URLs and model-summarised snippets but is dominated by stale cached data (mostly mid-2026) and cannot read JavaScript-rendered live portals (tenders.vic.gov.au, buy.nsw, QTenders, NT QTOL all render client-side and returned only 'JavaScript Disabled' shells), follow pagination, or open attachments. Tier 1 (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA/SA/TAS/ACT, NT QTOL), Tier 2 (VendorPanel public tenders, councils, water/energy GBEs, universities) and Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, Transgrid/ICN, NFP/aged-care, private transport/logistics) were all attempted via WebSearch only. No fresh (last-7-day) opportunity could be confirmed on any buyer-originated portal this run. The 5 currently-open opportunities previously captured on 2026-10-16..20 (when WebFetch worked) are carried forward at headline level because their published closing dates (2026-11-12 .. 2026-12-11) place them within their open windows today; one (Ports Victoria Station Pier) was independently re-corroborated this run from the buyer's own FY26-FY27 procurement activity plan PDF. No new sources were found this run: every buyer and portal surfaced (Forbes/East Gippsland/Woollahra/Gunnedah/Logan/Bundaberg councils, ICN, the QTenders EPW URL, Ariba Discovery) is already in the known source set.
gaps: CRITICAL TOOLING OUTAGE (unchanged from 2026-10-21): WebFetch returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host attempted (including www.tenders.gov.au); the agent-proxy status endpoint could not be queried (blocked). Outbound egress is blocked for this session, so no live tender portal, detail page or specification document could be opened. Only WebSearch was available.

Because detail pages were unreachable, NO deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria / document / contact extraction was possible this run. All 5 tenders are headline-level only and counted in entries_pending_detail; their headline fields derive from prior runs (2026-10-16..20) and must be re-verified on the live portals once egress is restored.

WebSearch index is stale: queries for 'October/November 2026' closings on every Tier 1 portal returned predominantly mid-2026 (closed) listings. Tier 1 live portals could not be crawled; exhaustive Tier 1 coverage was NOT achieved this run.

Tier 1 state portals (buy.nsw, tenders.vic, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) are JavaScript-rendered; search snippets showed only 'JavaScript Disabled' shells or cached pages, so current open-tender lists were not visible.

Of the 5 carried-forward tenders, only Ports Victoria Station Pier (T421508) was independently re-corroborated this run (via the buyer's FY26-FY27 procurement activity plan on ports.vic.gov.au). The other 4 (GPSnet EOI DOT46088, WorkCover occupational rehabilitation FOL26-3030, Latrobe Regional Health payroll RFQ2262, ACT Healthy Waterways PICE0014602) could not be re-confirmed on their live portals this run and are carried forward on the basis of their previously-captured, still-open published closing dates only.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Business Network Discovery (service.ariba.com/Discovery.aw), Transgrid/ICN project opportunities, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas/Transurban and NFP/aged-care supplier portals are registration/login-gated and/or not readable via WebSearch; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be confirmed. No corporate opportunities were invented. These portals remain recorded in prior discovered_sources.
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs) remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Source discovery: every buyer/portal surfaced via WebSearch this run was already present in the known source set (458 sources), so new_sources_found = 0. This is an honest nil result under degraded conditions, not a skipped step.
De-duplication: the 5 carried-forward tenders reuse their existing dedup_keys and retain their original first_seen dates (2026-10-17..20); the aggregator folds by min-date so lineage is preserved.
recommended_seed_additions: No new sources to add this run. Confirmed (already-known) URL note: Queensland's QTenders now resolves under the Department of Energy and Public Works at https://qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au/ (the older hpw.qld.gov.au host is a prior department name); suppliers must register in VendorPanel via https://www.supply.qld.gov.au/ to access documents. Both the EPW host and supply.qld are already in discovered_sources.
